display_name: Phase1 independent structured residual IQ prior
description: Train from scratch on normalized independent blind posterior residual directions from approved impaired source views, with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no DURA teacher or model.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Source clean IQ perturbed by normalized same-record independent blind posterior residual, randomly scaled at fixed levels; impaired source views 21,22,23,11,... first non-clean.
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX source labels or U_s truth; only clean source IQ and frozen F soft outputs

permissions.query_use: Approved source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated IQ and frozen F only; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or target test.
permissions.claim_scope: Prior training only, not a full restoration result or blind ground performance.

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh zero-residual denoiser; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no DURA.
sources: Independent blind action checkpoint 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107 and source Gaussian prior trained without DURA.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same source fit IDs as white-noise prior, independent blind action and source Gaussian prior; no DURA architecture, checkpoint or teacher.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 8192 randomly sampled source fit IDs disjoint from original prior IDs and source validation/holdout, 8 fixed epochs, final checkpoint.

dimensions: fixed source fit only; no TX label or validation scoring
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Posterior residual directions replace white Gaussian noise; per-record noise RMS matched, fixed sigma set, IQ, frozen F feature and soft-distribution losses; actual random sigma sequence differs.

rows.method: Independent structured-error prior for multi-step blind inverse
rows.purpose: learn source IQ prior without DURA teacher or architecture
rows.seed_notes: Model/noise seed 2026125054, source fit seed 2026125055, order seed 2026125056.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Independent blind physical model and source Gaussian prior determine residual direction; DURA absent from model and training.
Precomputed source-only per-record residual uses paired clean IQ, available during source training only; never at inference.
Candidate and evaluation selection pre-fixed before inspecting new validation or ground test.
Same F, architecture, fit IDs, optimizer and epoch count as prior; sampled noise levels may differ since white random draws are removed.
